router_savings.note: Router classification on the promoted valid contracts (n=203): 103 of 203 cases would need retrieval in a gated deployment. In this pipeline binding is a free local catalog lookup and ran for every case, so the saving is hypothetical: what gating would avoid where retrieval is remote or paid. Router states: NO_COVERAGE 49.3%, CONFLICT 27.1%, ROUTINE 23.6%, UNDECIDABLE 0.0%. CONFLICT cases can request guidance for both candidate conditions, so gated CALLS (106) exceed retrieving cases; the call-level saving is reported alongside the case-level one.

base_arm_reference.note: PRE-promotion pipeline on valid (n=203): router states NO_COVERAGE 55.7%, UNDECIDABLE 20.7%, ROUTINE 14.3%, CONFLICT 9.4%. Kept for comparison only; the promoted checklist disagrees with the classifier more often, so the promoted router retrieves more.

criterion_abstention.system: PROMOTED perception: argmax on the balanced 526-d heads, NO abstention gating
criterion_abstention.note: The promoted path reads every criterion by argmax (the criterion_abstention_v1 cutoffs were fit on the pre-promotion 512-d head and are not valid for the promoted heads), so abstention and undecidable rates are 0.0 BY CONSTRUCTION, not by measurement. Per-criterion top-minus-second margins are plumbed into every promoted contract so a future abstention policy can be re-fit.

base_arm_reference.note: PRE-promotion margin-based policy (criterion_abstention_v1): score-range design kept 107 cases decidable even with unknowns.

guideline_binding.note: In a gated deployment, triggered only for the cases the router classifies as needing retrieval (promoted: ~51% of valid cases; base arm: ~30%)

clinician_agent.cost_per_question: fractions of a cent (token-based; see total_pipeline_cost note)
clinician_agent.note: Only invoked when clinician asks a question, not per case

dermagent_comparison.dermagent_retry_mechanism: Critic with confidence thresholds (90%/80%), up to k_max retries
dermagent_comparison.note: Our pipeline makes 0 LLM calls per case for the decision. The LLM is invoked only when a clinician asks a question. DermAgent invokes the LLM controller for EVERY case.

total_pipeline_cost.note: <$2 total (token-based estimate; the per-call heuristic used previously overstates ~40x). Measured pricing: $0.10/1M prompt + $0.40/1M completion tokens; a comparable 270-call verifier study cost $0.068 total. No frontier model spend on this axis. The only prior frontier spend was G1c's one-off model sweep ($5.79).
